pathAssistantSteps.info: LOI finalized and complete. Record is closed out for this stage of the deal.
Draft the letter of intent - capture the offer price, cap rate and key terms. Keep it here until the draft is ready for internal review.
Prepare and review the LOI internally. Validate the terms, route it for any required approval, and refine based on feedback before finalizing.
LOI sent to the seller/broker. Awaiting their response - a counter moves it to the Counter stage.
Counter-offer stage. Track the back-and-forth with the seller - log each counter in the Counter History and update the offer terms until both sides align.
